subject: [hw] DONE K02 rev 5: final .inc sha 9b13fdd5 (slot close-all defensive cap); tests 588871
body:
DONE K02 rev 5 (supersedes the sha in rev 3/4; implementation otherwise identical).

Change since rev 4: one defensive line in n2vc_slot_close_all - if the caller-provided output array were smaller than the slot count, the leftover slot is left allocated for a later close instead of being dropped (the only caller passes N2VC_MAX_SLOTS, so no behaviour change; the host suite is unchanged).

  kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc sha256 9b13fdd5b8e11653...
  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST K02 PASS 588871/588871 (violations 0) x2 (ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2)
  staged kernel compile (full sweet_touch.c, exact CI flags, -Wall -Wextra -Werror): clean, 1,318,608-byte object, 9 new undefined symbols vs q10at3, 0 unknown.

Everything else (R2 F1-F4, opus-kern HIGH-1/2/3/MED-4, K02-L1/L2/L3, the not-done list) is as in rev 3. 0299 regen + compile_check remains IK's step. R2: sha 9b13fdd5 is the file to review.
